Inside a Transformer Block.zh: 深入一个 Transformer 模块

A transformer is a stack of identical bl.zh: Transformer 是一叠彼此相同的模块，每个模块都对一条不断流动的词元向量@@T0@@残差流@@T1@@做同样的六件小事。按下 @@T2@@步进@@T3@@，从头到尾走过一个模块：归一化，让注意力@@T4@@在位置之间混合信息@@T5@@，把它加回残差流，再次归一化，让前馈网络@@T6@@各自独立地变换每一个位置@@T7@@，然后再把它也加回去。
A transformer is a stack of identical bl.src: A transformer is a stack of identical blocks, and every block does the same six little things to a running residual stream of token vectors. Press Step to walk one block end to end: normalize, let attention mix information between positions, add it back to the stream, normalize again, let the feed-forward network transform each position on its own, and add that back too.

@@T0@@~10 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Le.zh:
@@T0@@约 10 分钟@@T1@@
      @@T2@@深度学习 · Transformer · 自注意力@@T3@@

One block, six moves, one stream.zh: 一个模块，六个动作，一条流
One block, six moves, one stream.src: One block, six moves, one stream

Feed a short sequence of tokens in as ro.zh: 把一段较短的词元序列作为矩阵 $X \in \mathbb{R}^{n\times d}$ 的各行输入 —— $n$ 个位置，每个位置是一个 $d$ 维向量。一个 Transformer 模块并不替换 $X$，而是@@T0@@编辑@@T1@@它。两个子层各自读取这条流、计算出一个修正量，再把这个修正量@@T2@@加@@T3@@回去。这就是残差流，而它的两次更新是：
Feed a short sequence of tokens in as ro.src: Feed a short sequence of tokens in as rows of a matrix $X \in \mathbb{R}^{n\times d}$ — $n$ positions, each a $d$-dimensional vector. A transformer block does not replace $X$; it edits it. Two sublayers each read the stream, compute a correction, and add that correction back. This is the residual stream, and its two updates are:

Everything hinges on @@T0@@who talks to.zh: 一切都取决于@@T0@@谁与谁交谈@@T1@@。注意力是信息@@T2@@在@@T3@@位置之间流动的唯一场所；前馈网络则@@T4@@独立地@@T5@@作用于每一个位置。LayerNorm 与残差加法则是让这叠得很深的网络在数值上保持平稳的管道工程。下方的小组件会带着四个词元精确地走过一个模块，一次一个动作。
Everything hinges on @@T0@@who talks to.src: Everything hinges on who talks to whom. Attention is the only place information moves between positions; the feed-forward network touches each position independently. LayerNorm and the residual adds are the plumbing that keeps this deep stack numerically calm. The widget below takes four tokens through exactly one block, one move at a time.

Step the residual stream through one blo.zh: 让残差流逐步走过一个模块
Step the residual stream through one blo.src: Step the residual stream through one block

The diagram is the wiring; the heatmaps.zh: 示意图展示的是接线关系；热力图则是实际的数值（固定，带种子）。暖色单元为正，蓝色单元为负，深浅表示幅度。按下 @@T0@@步进@@T1@@ 执行六步中的下一步 —— 观察残差流（底部）@@T2@@只在@@T3@@两处「+」加法处发生变化，而在分支计算过程中绝不改变。
The diagram is the wiring; the heatmaps.src: The diagram is the wiring; the heatmaps are the actual numbers (fixed, seeded). Warm cells are positive, blue cells negative, intensity is magnitude. Press Step to perform the next of the six moves — watch the residual stream (bottom) change only at the two “+” adds, never during the branch computations.

The residual stream (green when it updat.zh: 残差流（更新时显示为绿色）笔直向下延伸；每个子层都从它分出一条支路，计算完成后在「+」处加回。
The residual stream (green when it updat.src: The residual stream (green when it updates) runs straight down; each sublayer branches off, is computed, and is added back at a “+”.

@@T0@@Start@@T1@@\n The four to.zh:
@@T0@@开始@@T1@@
          四个词元向量原封不动地停在残差流中。按下 @@T2@@步进@@T3@@ 开始运行该模块。
@@T0@@Start@@T1@@\n The four to.src: Start The four token vectors sit in the residual stream, untouched. Press Step to begin the block.

The current move, computed on a branch o.zh: 当前动作，是在从残差流分出的支路上计算得到的。
The current move, computed on a branch o.src: The current move, computed on a branch off the stream.

The residual stream $X$ (nx d). It chang.zh: 残差流 $X$（n× d）。它@@T0@@只在@@T1@@两处残差加法处发生变化；LayerNorm、注意力与 FFN 都读取它，但先写入支路。
The residual stream $X$ (nx d). It chang.src: The residual stream $X$ (nx d). It changes only at the two residual adds; LayerNorm, attention and the FFN all read it but write to a branch first.

@@T0@@Watch the attention move.@@T1@@ At.zh: @@T0@@留意注意力的那一步。@@T1@@ 在第 2 步，$n\times n$ 的权重矩阵亮起：第 $i$ 行告诉你位置 $i$ 从每一个位置 $j$ 汲取了多少信息。「down」的输出字面上就是全部四个值向量的混合 $\sum_j A_{ij}\,v_j$ —— 这正是信息@@T2@@在@@T3@@词元之间流动。模块中再无别处会发生这种事。
@@T0@@Watch the attention move.@@T1@@ At.src: Watch the attention move. At step 2 the $n\times n$ weight matrix lights up: row $i$ tells you how much position $i$ pulls from every position $j$. The output for “down” is literally a blend $\sum_j A_{ij}\,v_j$ of all four value vectors — that is information travelling between tokens. Nowhere else in the block does that happen.

Why this shape, and why it stacks.zh: 为何是这个形状，又为何能够堆叠
Why this shape, and why it stacks.src: Why this shape, and why it stacks

A block is a careful division of labour..zh: 一个模块是一次精心设计的分工。注意力决定@@T0@@从何处读取什么@@T1@@；FFN 决定@@T2@@如何处置每个位置此刻所持有的内容@@T3@@。把「搬运信息」与「处理信息」彼此分开，正是同一个模块得以被堆叠数十次的原因。
A block is a careful division of labour..src: A block is a careful division of labour. Attention decides what to read from where; the FFN decides what to do with what each position now holds. Separating “move information” from “process information” is what lets the same block be stacked dozens of times.

@@T0@@Attention mixes positions.@@T1@@ E.zh: @@T0@@注意力混合各个位置。@@T1@@ 每一输出行都是来自@@T2@@全部@@T3@@位置的值向量的加权平均。这是词元之间相互影响的唯一通道。
@@T0@@Attention mixes positions.@@T1@@ E.src: Attention mixes positions. Every output row is a weighted average of value vectors from all positions. This is the one and only channel for tokens to influence each other.

@@T0@@The FFN is position-wise.@@T1@@ Th.zh: @@T0@@FFN 是逐位置作用的。@@T1@@ 同一个小型 MLP 被独立地施加于每一行 —— 任何一行都看不到另一行。Transformer 的大部分参数（以及它所存储的大量知识）正栖身于此。
@@T0@@The FFN is position-wise.@@T1@@ Th.src: The FFN is position-wise. The same little MLP is applied to each row on its own — no row ever sees another. It is where most of a transformer's parameters (and much of its stored knowledge) live.

@@T0@@Residual + norm keep the stream st.zh: @@T0@@残差 + 归一化保持流的稳定。@@T1@@ 由于每个子层都只是@@T2@@加上@@T3@@一个修正量，梯度便获得一条直达输入的高速公路，而 LayerNorm 让每一行保持在合理的尺度上，因此 96 层的堆叠依然可以训练。
@@T0@@Residual + norm keep the stream st.src: Residual + norm keep the stream stable. Because each sublayer only adds a correction, gradients get a clean highway straight back to the input, and LayerNorm keeps every row at a sane scale so 96-layer stacks still train.

@@T0@@Pre-norm vs post-norm.@@T1@@ This.zh: @@T0@@前置归一化与后置归一化。@@T1@@ 本组件展示的是现代的@@T2@@前置归一化@@T3@@布局 —— LayerNorm 位于每条支路的@@T4@@内部@@T5@@，因此残差流本身从不被归一化，只被加法更新。正是这条未被触碰的高速公路，使得极深的 Transformer（GPT、LLaMA）能够稳定训练，而最初的 post-norm 设计则需要精心预热。
@@T0@@Pre-norm vs post-norm.@@T1@@ This.src: Pre-norm vs post-norm. This widget shows the modern pre-norm arrangement — LayerNorm sits inside each branch, so the residual stream itself is never normalized, only added to. That untouched highway is exactly why very deep transformers (GPT, LLaMA) train stably where the original post-norm design needed careful warm-up.

meta.title: 深入一个 Transformer 模块
meta.tagline: 让残差流一步步走过一个模块，看注意力如何混合各个位置，而 FFN 则各自独立地处理每个位置
meta.summary: Transformer 是一叠彼此相同的模块，每个模块都用六个小动作编辑一条不断流动的残差流。按下步进，从头到尾走过一个模块：LayerNorm、自注意力（其 n x n 权重矩阵在各个位置之间混合值向量）、一次残差加法、再次 LayerNorm、一个逐位置的前馈网络，最后再来一次残差加法。实时的模块示意图会高亮当前活跃的子层，而热力图则展示真实数值，使核心要点一目了然：注意力是信息在词元之间流动的唯一场所，FFN 各自独立地处理每一个词元，而残差流只在两处加法处发生变化。
highlights: 让一个 Transformer 模块走遍全部六个动作，看实时的模块示意图高亮当前活跃的子层。
观察 n x n 的注意力矩阵，以及每个输出行如何成为跨位置的值向量加权混合。
确认残差流只在两处「+」加法处发生变化——LayerNorm、注意力与 FFN 都先在支路上计算。
对比注意力（在位置之间混合信息）与前馈网络（独立变换每一个位置）。
领会为何残差连接加上前置归一化的 LayerNorm，才能让数十个这样的模块堆叠起来仍然可以训练。
